SERVICE_INFORMATION.TITLE: E035/26: CX-6e (HDC) - CX-6e Hood Closing Characteristics
SERVICE_INFORMATION.SI_HISTORY: Newly created according to MC S/I E035/26 issued on October 29, 2026.
SERVICE_INFORMATION.DESCRIPTION:
Compared with previous Mazda vehicles, some customers may feel that the hood requires more force to close. However, if the hood is closed using the procedure described in the Owner's Manual, proper latching can be achieved. This Service Information describes how to inspect and, if necessary, adjust the hood buffer cushions.


ACTIONS TO BE TAKEN
When a customer complains that the hood is difficult to close, compare the hood closing effort with that of another vehicle of the same model, and confirm whether the closing effort is abnormal.
If adjustment is determined to be necessary, adjust the hood buffer cushions according to the Workshop Manual <HOOD HEIGHT DIFFERENCE ADJUSTMENT>.
After the adjustment, close the hood again and verify that the hood closing effort is acceptable. Also verify that the hood is securely latched.

CAUTION:
  • Always follow the Owner's Manual when opening or closing the hood.
  • After adjusting the hood buffer cushions, verify that the height of the hood front edge is even on both the left and right sides.
